name: Pterorhynchus
sum: Long-tailed pterosaur with a large keratin head crest, from the Daohugou beds of Inner Mongolia, China.
holotype: CAGS02-IG-gausa-2/M 608 — Daohugou beds, Chifeng, Inner Mongolia.
exceptional: Wing membrane, pycnofibres, a long tail vane, and a crest with a bony base and large keratin extension.
biology: Skull 11.8 cm; its describers suggested the crest had an aerodynamic function.
author: Czerkas and Ji 2002

species.name: Pterorhynchus wellnhoferi
species.author: Czerkas and Ji 2002
species.ref: S. A. Czerkas and Q. Ji. 2002. A new rhamphorhynchoid with a headcrest and complex integumentary structures. Feathered Dinosaurs and the Origin of Flight, The Dinosaur Museum, Blanding
